subject: getting figures on same scale when data ranges are different

messages.author: 9783d9fe56013431
messages.subject: getting figures on same scale when data ranges are different
parts:
Hi
I have three datasets that I want to make three identically scaled
figures for but the data have different ranges. (I am not using
facet_grid because I need some information on X axis of each figure).


The largest dataset goes from 0-100,000,000 on the X axis and the
other two are shorter. In order to get these three on the same scale,
I have used:

scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,100000000)) for each plot

which works great, but now I have a lot of white space in the smaller
datasets due to the black box that surrounds each plot.

I like the black box, so I prefer to keep it but I'm not sure how to
modify it so that it doesn't block in the whole
x axis range from 0 -10000000 but rather stops when the data stops
(say 20,000,000).

Thank you.
Squid.
